requirements.text: Start and resume a useful lesson without login or purchase.
First alpha includes a complete authored beginner learning journey, not only playback.
Pitch, note name, notation, keyboard and audio representations remain consistent.
Playback, pause, seek, count-in, tempo and loop have deterministic safe behavior.
Hand selection depends on explicit mapping; hand, staff, voice and track are not interchangeable.
Hints and contextual theory can be reduced and restored without losing position.
Self-report, screen interaction and physical MIDI evidence are distinguished; no fabricated grading.
Local progress is durable, versioned, exportable and recoverable without silent data loss.
Prepared lessons run offline; resource completeness, eviction and update failures have honest states.
Only documented import subsets are playable; unsupported semantics are never silently dropped.
Bundled content and dependencies have recorded distributable rights; user imports stay private/local.
One responsive product and token/component contract across phone, tablet and desktop.
Accessible keyboard/touch/screen-reader operation, contrast, focus and reduced motion.
Russian and English copy plus explicit pitch naming conventions; no mixed locale or B/H ambiguity.
Runtime capability detection, user-triggered permissions and graceful unsupported-device fallback.
No mandatory paid infrastructure/API/telemetry; explicit gates before spending or cloud processing.
Audio timing, rendering cost, UI responsiveness and cleanup have measured acceptance checks.
Pinned compatible toolchain, real scripts, CI and reproducible builds when implementation starts.
Negative tests and recovery paths are first-class; all claimed checks have evidence.
Native implementations preserve product semantics and pass real platform lifecycle tests.
Learning progress uses bounded heuristics, not unvalidated claims of professional mastery.
Every release requirement maps to task outputs, visual/behavior contracts and acceptance evidence.
Educational and musical reference material is checked; no invented chord/fingering/original-score claims.
Agents respect resource isolation, dependencies, review, approvals and current verified state.
